units.i2v_prompt: Single continuous take at 24fps, 16:9. A close-up at eye level; the camera slides laterally with small amplitude in shallow focus, easing in at the start and settling to a stop at the end. The night sky in close detail: countless round pin-points of pale warm light, all the same tiny size, spread evenly through deep blue-black, the darkness between them clean and even. A haze of fine dust sits evenly across the whole frame, warm in tone and so faint it stays close to the sky's own brightness, even and flat from edge to edge, its edges soft and open, every speck still resolvable on its own. Warm 2000 Taiwanese telecine grade, milky lifted blacks. Visible 35mm film grain. Restrained continuous motion, camera and subject motion only.
